proposed_widenings.name: sense-gated roll modifier predicate
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can narrow roll modifiers by skill, but not by whether the check relies on sight. Encoding plain Perception advantage would overgrant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The robe gives you Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

proposed_widenings.name: triggered passive mechanics for magic items
proposed_widenings.justification: Passive magic items currently support always-on grants only. Robe of Eyes also has a deterministic drawback triggered by external spell events while worn.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A Light spell cast on the robe or a Daylight spell cast within 5 feet of the robe gives you the Blinded condition for 1 minute.

proposed_widenings.name: item-exposure named-spell trigger
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing trigger grammar does not represent named spells cast on a worn item or within a radius of that item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A Light spell cast on the robe or a Daylight spell cast within 5 feet of the robe...

proposed_widenings.name: trigger-parameterized repeat-save drawback
proposed_widenings.justification: The repeat save exists conceptually, but its DC depends on which trigger branch caused the blinded condition. The current passive-item surface cannot carry that branch-specific parameterization.
proposed_widenings.evidence: At the end of each of your turns, you make a Constitution saving throw (DC 11 for Light or DC 15 for Daylight), ending the condition on yourself on a success.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. The item's always-on senses mostly fit, but the sight-only Perception rider and triggered blindness drawback cannot be represented honestly with the current passive magic-item surface.
